entries.title: Close the keyboard from the reply on iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, while you type a reply under a card or a message to your first mate, a keyboard-down button sits inside the field just before the send arrow, and a press closes the keyboard. Pulling down anywhere on the card, or tapping its head, closes it too. Your words and photos stay, and the card's choices stay where they are.
entries.noPicture: The phone check pictures the reply on iPhone and iPad upright, while a hero picture is a landscape pair cropped from the desktop app's window.
